messages:
Avery: Quick sync — finalizing Optimize Toolkit launch gating. Need clear acceptance for batching / caching / quantization recommendations and eval-triggered alerts. Proposal: three launch lanes (alpha: internal; beta: select customers; GA: public). Primary questions: minimal acceptance criteria, rollback/fallback plan, and Console UX for apply/visibility.
Raj: +1. Core infra asks: define SLOs (p95/p99 latency), max cost uplift per request, and a safe default batching policy. Also tenant isolation for cache.
Mei: Implementation notes: KV prefix cache with per-tenant namespaces + LRU eviction. For continuous batching we need adaptive windowing — can default to 50ms but feature flag it. Concern: cold-start KV warms.
Sam: On model side: quantization recs must include a quality regression bar. I suggest we require a model-quality delta <= 1.5% on our eval suites (concordance + perplexity where applicable). Also provide toggles to prefer FP16 vs 8-bit in runtime.
Nora: From customers: they want per-route guidance and an "apply recommendations" button in Console. Also audit logs for changes. If alerts trigger (eval regression), they want automatic notify + optional auto-rollback to previous quantization profile.
Ian: Draft acceptance checklist: 
- Documentation: public doc + quickstart (apply / revert flows).
- Metrics: p95 latency change < 10% vs baseline for target routes; cost/unit <= target uplift (see table). 
- Quality: eval delta <= 1.5% on golden prompt sets. 
- Ops: feature flags + canary rollout support + clear rollback (auto-fallback to non-quantized model). 
- UX: Console flow for recommendations + audit trail.

Code snippet for automated regression test (pseudo):
```
# run eval harness
results = run_eval(model_variant, golden_prompts)
assert results['concordance_drop'] <= 0.015
```
Raj: Ops checks: need autoscaler guardrails for batching-induced burst. Suggest limit batch_size <= 128 and dynamic timeout floor 10ms / cap 200ms. Also include a cost budget circuit breaker: if 7-day rolling cost uplift > 8%, disable recommendations for that tenant.
Mei: Agree. We'll add telemetry events: optimize.recommendation.applied, optimize.eval.alert, optimize.rollback.triggered. Deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for canary tomorrow 09:00 PT. 
deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued: optimize-advisor v0.9 -> canary.eta 2026-03-24T16:00:00Z
Avery: Decision needed: Do we gate GA on customer beta feedback (NPS >= 30) or just passing internal acceptance? My vote: require at least 3 beta customers with no high-sev regressions. 
Nora: +1. We'll onboard 4 pilot customers and collect feedback. 
Sam: One more: add an eval-triggered alert taxonomy doc — severity levels, who to page, and auto-actions. I'll draft and share today. 
Ian: Action items: 
- Raj/Mei: finalize infra thresholds + telemetry by EOD Thu. 
- Sam: quality thresholds + eval harness integration by Tue. 
- Nora: pilot customer list and onboarding plan by Fri. 
- Avery/Ian: finalize release lanes & GA gating criteria next Mon sync. 
Avery: Thanks — ping me for any blockers. :thumbsup:
